import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem bounded_offset_even_power_mod_three (B q n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ B) : 2 ^ (2 * (q + n)) % 3 = 1 ∧ ∃ t : ℕ, 2 ^ (2 * (q + n)) = 3 * t + 1 := by
  have hpow :
      ∀ k : ℕ,
        2 ^ (2 * k) % 3 = 1 ∧
          ∃ t : ℕ, 2 ^ (2 * k) = 3 * t + 1 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        constructor
        · norm_num
        · exact ⟨0, by norm_num⟩
    | succ k ih =>
        rcases ih with ⟨hmod, ⟨t, ht⟩⟩
        constructor
        · calc
            2 ^ (2 * Nat.succ k) % 3 =
                ((2 ^ (2 * k) % 3) * (2 ^ 2 % 3)) % 3 := by
                  rw [Nat.mul_succ, pow_add, Nat.mul_mod]
            _ = 1 := by
              norm_num [hmod]
        · refine ⟨4 * t + 1, ?_⟩
          calc
            2 ^ (2 * Nat.succ k) =
                2 ^ (2 * k) * 2 ^ 2 := by
                  rw [Nat.mul_succ, pow_add]
            _ = (3 * t + 1) * 4 := by
              rw [ht]
              norm_num
            _ = 3 * (4 * t + 1) + 1 := by
              ring
  exact hpow (q + n)
